title: Staff
subtitle: Your team, their roles and what they can see.
inviteSubtitle: They'll get an email with a link to set their password.
emptyHint: Invite your dentists, reception and back-office team.

fields.name: Full name
fields.bookableOnline: Patients can book online with this person

deactivateBody: They won't be able to sign in to this clinic. Their history stays.
rolesHint: Effective permissions are the union of all assigned roles, then any custom permissions below.
specialtiesHint: Dental specialties. Patients use them to find the right doctor; they never limit what a doctor may do.
primarySpecialtyHint: Shown first on prescriptions, plans and booking.
ownerProtected: This is the clinic owner. Only the owner can change their access or status.
noDefaultRole: No default role for this type: choose one, or the owner can assign Full access.
ownerControlledRole: Only the clinic owner can grant or remove this role.
selfAccessLocked: You can't change your own roles or permissions. Ask the clinic owner.

transfer.title: Clinic ownership
transfer.hint: The owner has full, protected authority over this clinic. There is always exactly one owner.
transfer.warning: You will stop being the owner. You keep your current roles, and the new owner can change them.

overridesHint: Overrides replace what the roles give for that permission. Use “Remove” to take a permission away.
noOverrides: No custom permissions — this person has exactly what their roles give.
ownerHasAll: Owners can see and do everything in the clinic.
